schema_description: Portable first-run operator continuity profile. Personal identity, memory, credentials, machine state, and project history must be stored outside the release payload.

preferences.fake_green_intolerance: No completion claim without evidence for the exact runtime path.
preferences.receipts_required: Record mutations, evidence, blockers, and rollback pointers.

current_intent_summary: Discover this operator, this project, and this hardware before accepting autonomous work.

invariants.name: NO_FAKE_GREEN
invariants.rule: Evidence for the exact path is required before green.

invariants.name: SOURCE_TRUTH_PRESERVED
invariants.rule: Indexes and compressed views never replace source truth.

invariants.name: SECRETS_EXTERNAL
invariants.rule: Credentials and private memory remain outside the product payload.

invariants.name: BOUNDED_EXECUTION
invariants.rule: Models propose; governed tools perform effects.
